definitions.perfect_document: At least one scored aligned cell and every scored aligned cell equals MATCH after canonicalization. Excludes masked/null cells, unmatched blank/total output rows, unscored metadata/structure/classification; not byte-exact output or autonomous acceptance.
definitions.blank_or_zero_answers: Raw answer None/empty/0 among scored cells; numeric zero remains a legitimate clinical/billing value. Shows cell weighting/sample composition, not inappropriateness.
definitions.accuracy: Micro-average aligned scored cells: MATCH/(MATCH+MISMATCH+MISSING+EXTRA). Zero/blank equivalent for amount keys, null/masked excluded; uncertain notes can force matches (none r9/r10).
